B21 l.646–674 against the proof structure. M₀ = M ∖ J⁺(κ⁻¹Π), a Cauchy surface below Π (a level of a Cauchy time function, lower than min T on the compact κ⁻¹Π), S Cauchy in M₀ (the c₀ part), M₀ connected (implicit in B21, reported as a finding), M₀ → M a Cauchy embedding. All are now formal. The two remaining leaves (M₂ GH; Σ Cauchy in M₂, the c = c₀ ∪ c₁ argument) are what is left of l.663–672.
